```{r spray_and_splits}
# ============================================================
# 13. SPRAY / BATTED-BALL PROFILE
# ============================================================

build_spray <- function(events, focal_id, min_bip = 8) {
  if (is.null(events) || nrow(events) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  bip <- events |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is_focal, is_pa, !is.na(actor_id),
      !is_k, !is_bb, !is_hbp
    )
  if (nrow(bip) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  bip |>
    dplyr::group_by(actor_id, Player = actor) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      BIP     = dplyr::n(),
      DirN    = sum(!is.na(direction)),
      Left    = sum(direction == "Left", na.rm = TRUE),
      Center  = sum(direction == "Center", na.rm = TRUE),
      Right   = sum(direction == "Right", na.rm = TRUE),
      TypeN   = sum(!is.na(bb_type)),
      GB      = sum(bb_type == "GB", na.rm = TRUE),
      LD      = sum(bb_type == "LD", na.rm = TRUE),
      FB      = sum(bb_type == "FB", na.rm = TRUE),
      PU      = sum(bb_type == "PU", na.rm = TRUE),
      HR      = sum(bb_type == "HR", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      LeftPct   = rate_per(Left,   DirN),
      CenterPct = rate_per(Center, DirN),
      RightPct  = rate_per(Right,  DirN),
      GBPct     = rate_per(GB, TypeN),
      AirPct    = rate_per(FB + LD + PU + HR, TypeN),
      DirCover  = rate_per(DirN, BIP),
      Lean = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(LeftPct) | DirN < min_bip ~ "—",
        LeftPct  >= 0.50 ~ "Left side",
        RightPct >= 0.50 ~ "Right side",
        CenterPct >= 0.45 ~ "Middle",
        TRUE ~ "Spread"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(BIP))
}


# ============================================================
# 14. HITTER SITUATIONAL SPLITS (PBP-DERIVED)
# ============================================================

split_line <- function(df, label) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      Split = label, PA = 0L, H = 0L, BB = 0L, K = 0L,
      OB = NA_real_, Kpct = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    Split = label,
    PA    = nrow(df),
    H     = sum(df$is_hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    BB    = sum(df$is_bb, na.rm = TRUE),
    K     = sum(df$is_k, na.rm = TRUE),
    OB    = rate_per(
      sum(df$is_hit, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(df$is_bb, na.rm = TRUE) +
        sum(df$is_hbp, na.rm = TRUE),
      nrow(df)
    ),
    Kpct  = rate_per(sum(df$is_k, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(df))
  )
}

build_team_situational <- function(events, side = c("offense", "defense")) {
  side <- match.arg(side)
  if (is.null(events) || nrow(events) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  pa <- events |>
    dplyr::filter(is_pa, if (side == "offense") is_focal else !is_focal)
  if (nrow(pa) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    split_line(pa, "All plate appearances"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, risp_before %in% TRUE), "Runners in scoring position"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, !(risp_before %in% TRUE)), "Bases empty / no RISP"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, leadoff %in% TRUE), "Leading off an inning"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, pa_index %in% 1), "First look (1st PA of game)"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, pa_index >= 3), "Third look or later"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, inning <= 3), "Innings 1-3"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, inning >= 4 & inning <= 6), "Innings 4-6"),
    split_line(dplyr::filter(pa, inning >= 7), "Innings 7+"),
    split_line(
      dplyr::filter(pa, stringr::str_to_lower(home_away) == "home"), "At home"
    ),
    split_line(
      dplyr::filter(pa, stringr::str_to_lower(home_away) == "away"), "On the road"
    )
  )
}

build_hitter_splits <- function(events, min_pa = 20) {
  if (is.null(events) || nrow(events) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  pa <- events |> dplyr::filter(is_focal, is_pa, !is.na(actor_id))
  if (nrow(pa) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  pa |>
    dplyr::group_by(actor_id, Player = actor) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      PA       = dplyr::n(),
      OB       = rate_per(sum(is_hit) + sum(is_bb) + sum(is_hbp), dplyr::n()),
      Kpct     = rate_per(sum(is_k), dplyr::n()),
      BBpct    = rate_per(sum(is_bb), dplyr::n()),
      RISP_PA  = sum(risp_before %in% TRUE),
      RISP_H   = sum(is_hit & risp_before %in% TRUE),
      RISP_K   = sum(is_k & risp_before %in% TRUE),
      Lead_PA  = sum(leadoff %in% TRUE),
      Lead_OB  = rate_per(
        sum((is_hit | is_bb | is_hbp) & leadoff %in% TRUE),
        sum(leadoff %in% TRUE)
      ),
      First_OB = rate_per(
        sum((is_hit | is_bb | is_hbp) & pa_index %in% 1),
        sum(pa_index %in% 1)
      ),
      Later_OB = rate_per(
        sum((is_hit | is_bb | is_hbp) & pa_index >= 3),
        sum(pa_index >= 3)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      RISP_avg = rate_per(RISP_H, RISP_PA),
      Enough   = PA >= min_pa
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(PA))
}


# ============================================================
# 15. RUNNING GAME
# ============================================================

build_running_game <- function(events, n_games) {
  blank <- list(
    totals = tibble::tibble(Metric = character(), Value = character()),
    players = tibble::tibble()
  )
  if (is.null(events) || nrow(events) == 0) return(blank)

  off <- dplyr::filter(events, is_focal)
  if (nrow(off) == 0) return(blank)

  steals   <- dplyr::filter(off, is_steal)
  caught   <- dplyr::filter(off, is_cs)
  picked   <- dplyr::filter(off, is_po)
  bunts    <- dplyr::filter(off, is_bunt)
  sacs     <- dplyr::filter(off, is_sac_bunt)

  attempts <- nrow(steals) + nrow(caught)
  per_game <- function(n) if (n_games > 0) fmt(n / n_games, 2) else "—"

  totals <- tibble::tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "Stolen bases", "Caught stealing", "Steal attempts",
      "Steal success rate", "Picked off", "Bunt attempts", "Sacrifice bunts"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(nrow(steals)),
      as.character(nrow(caught)),
      as.character(attempts),
      if (attempts > 0) fmt_pct(nrow(steals) / attempts) else "—",
      as.character(nrow(picked)),
      as.character(nrow(bunts)),
      as.character(nrow(sacs))
    ),
    PerGame = c(
      per_game(nrow(steals)), per_game(nrow(caught)), per_game(attempts),
      "", per_game(nrow(picked)), per_game(nrow(bunts)), per_game(nrow(sacs))
    )
  )

  runners <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    dplyr::mutate(steals, .kind = "SB"),
    dplyr::mutate(caught, .kind = "CS"),
    dplyr::mutate(bunts,  .kind = "BUNT")
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(actor_id))

  players <- if (nrow(runners) == 0) tibble::tibble() else {
    runners |>
      dplyr::group_by(actor_id, Player = actor) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        SB   = sum(.kind == "SB"),
        CS   = sum(.kind == "CS"),
        Bunt = sum(.kind == "BUNT"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Att = SB + CS,
        Success = rate_per(SB, Att)
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Att), dplyr::desc(Bunt)) |>
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 8)
  }

  list(totals = totals, players = players)
}


# ============================================================
# 16. PITCHER SPLITS FROM THE BOX SCORES
# ============================================================
# Attributing a play to the pitcher on the mound is not reliable
# from ESPN college play-by-play, so per-pitcher splits are built
# from box-score appearances, which are complete. Anything that
# needs the man on the mound is reported at staff level instead
# and labelled that way.

pitcher_role_splits <- function(pit_rows, sched_completed) {
  if (is.null(pit_rows) || nrow(pit_rows) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  ctx <- sched_completed |>
    dplyr::select(game_id = event_id, home_away, d1_opponent)

  rows <- dplyr::left_join(pit_rows, ctx, by = "game_id")

  summarise_slice <- function(df, label) {
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
    df |>
      dplyr::group_by(athlete_id, Player) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        Split = label,
        App   = dplyr::n_distinct(game_id),
        Outs  = sum(Outs, na.rm = TRUE),
        H     = sum(H, na.rm = TRUE),
        ER    = sum(ER, na.rm = TRUE),
        BB    = sum(BB, na.rm = TRUE),
        K     = sum(K, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarise_slice(dplyr::filter(rows, starter %in% TRUE), "As starter"),
    summarise_slice(dplyr::filter(rows, !(starter %in% TRUE)), "In relief"),
    summarise_slice(
      dplyr::filter(rows, stringr::str_to_lower(home_away) == "home"), "At home"
    ),
    summarise_slice(
      dplyr::filter(rows, stringr::str_to_lower(home_away) == "away"), "On the road"
    ),
    summarise_slice(dplyr::filter(rows, d1_opponent %in% TRUE), "vs Division I"),
    summarise_slice(dplyr::filter(rows, !(d1_opponent %in% TRUE)), "vs non-D1 / unlisted")
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      IPnum = outs_to_ip_num(Outs),
      IP    = outs_to_ip_chr(Outs),
      ERA   = rate_per(ER, IPnum, 9),
      WHIP  = rate_per(BB + H, IPnum),
      K9    = rate_per(K, IPnum, 9),
      BB9   = rate_per(BB, IPnum, 9)
    )
}

starter_workload <- function(pit_rows) {
  if (is.null(pit_rows) || nrow(pit_rows) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  starts <- dplyr::filter(pit_rows, starter %in% TRUE)
  if (nrow(starts) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  starts |>
    dplyr::group_by(athlete_id, Player) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      GS         = dplyr::n_distinct(game_id),
      MedOuts    = stats::median(Outs, na.rm = TRUE),
      MaxOuts    = suppressWarnings(max(Outs, na.rm = TRUE)),
      MedPitches = stats::median(Pitches[Pitches > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
      MaxPitches = suppressWarnings(max(Pitches, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      TypicalIP = outs_to_ip_chr(round(MedOuts)),
      LongestIP = outs_to_ip_chr(ifelse(is.finite(MaxOuts), MaxOuts, NA)),
      MedPitches = ifelse(is.finite(MedPitches), MedPitches, NA_real_),
      MaxPitches = ifelse(is.finite(MaxPitches), MaxPitches, NA_real_)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(GS), dplyr::desc(MedOuts))
}
```

```{r baseline_flags_plan}
# ============================================================
# 17. DIVISION I BASELINE + PERCENTILES
# ============================================================

build_d1_baseline <- function(season, refresh = FALSE) {
  raw <- cache_get(
    c("espn_standings", season),
    function() baseballr::espn_college_baseball_standings(year = season),
    refresh = refresh,
    fallback = tibble::tibble(),
    source  = "ESPN",
    label   = "Division I standings"
  )
  if (is.null(raw) || nrow(raw) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  x <- janitor::clean_names(raw)
  team_col <- pick_col(x, c("team", "team_name", "display_name"))
  if (is.na(team_col)) return(tibble::tibble())

  out <- tibble::tibble(
    Team     = as.character(x[[team_col]]),
    TeamNorm = normalize_team_name(x[[team_col]]),
    G   = col_or_na(x, c("gamesplayed", "games_played")),
    W   = col_or_na(x, c("wins")),
    L   = col_or_na(x, c("losses")),
    RF  = col_or_na(x, c("pointsfor", "points_for")),
    RA  = col_or_na(x, c("pointsagainst", "points_against")),
    RDt = col_or_na(x, c("pointdifferential", "point_differential")),
    WPu = col_or_na(x, c("winpercent", "win_percent"))
  )

  out |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(G), G > 0) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      WinPct = dplyr::if_else(is.finite(WPu) & WPu > 0, WPu, rate_per(W, G)),
      R_G    = rate_per(RF, G),
      RA_G   = rate_per(RA, G),
      RD_G   = dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(R_G) & is.finite(RA_G), R_G - RA_G, rate_per(RDt, G)
      )
    )
}

find_team_in_baseline <- function(baseline, team_query, team_name, abbreviation) {
  if (is.null(baseline) || nrow(baseline) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  candidates <- unique(normalize_team_name(c(team_name, team_query, abbreviation)))
  candidates <- candidates[nchar(candidates) > 1]

  exact <- baseline[baseline$TeamNorm %in% candidates, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(exact) >= 1) return(exact[1, , drop = FALSE])

  for (cand in candidates) {
    if (nchar(cand) < 3) next
    hit <- baseline[
      stringr::str_detect(baseline$TeamNorm, stringr::fixed(cand)) |
        stringr::str_detect(cand, stringr::fixed(baseline$TeamNorm)),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(hit) >= 1) return(hit[1, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  tibble::tibble()
}

rank_and_percentile <- function(value, population, higher_is_better = TRUE) {
  population <- population[is.finite(population)]
  if (!is.finite(value) || length(population) < 25) {
    return(list(pct = NA_real_, rank = NA_integer_, n = length(population)))
  }
  better <- if (higher_is_better) sum(population > value) else sum(population < value)
  list(
    pct  = 100 * mean(if (higher_is_better) population <= value else population >= value),
    rank = as.integer(better + 1),
    n    = length(population)
  )
}

build_percentile_table <- function(baseline, target_row) {
  if (is.null(target_row) || nrow(target_row) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  spec <- list(
    list("Win Percentage", target_row$WinPct, baseline$WinPct, TRUE,
         fmt_pct(target_row$WinPct, 1)),
    list("Runs / Game", target_row$R_G, baseline$R_G, TRUE,
         fmt(target_row$R_G, 2)),
    list("Run Prevention", target_row$RA_G, baseline$RA_G, FALSE,
         paste0(fmt(target_row$RA_G, 2), " RA/G")),
    list("Run Differential / Game", target_row$RD_G, baseline$RD_G, TRUE,
         fmt_signed(target_row$RD_G, 2))
  )

  purrr::map_dfr(spec, function(s) {
    rp <- rank_and_percentile(s[[2]], s[[3]], s[[4]])
    tibble::tibble(
      Metric     = s[[1]],
      Display    = s[[5]],
      Percentile = rp$pct,
      Rank       = rp$rank,
      Pool       = rp$n
    )
  })
}


# ============================================================
# 18. AUTOMATED FLAGS
# ============================================================

build_flags <- function(season_metrics, recent_metrics, team_rates,
                        percentiles, thresholds, window_label) {
  flags <- list()
  add <- function(title, body, type = "info") {
    flags[[length(flags) + 1]] <<- tibble::tibble(
      Title = title, Body = body, Type = type
    )
  }

  pct_of <- function(metric) {
    if (nrow(percentiles) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    row <- percentiles[percentiles$Metric == metric, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(row) == 0) NA_real_ else row$Percentile[[1]]
  }
  rank_text <- function(metric) {
    if (nrow(percentiles) == 0) return("")
    row <- percentiles[percentiles$Metric == metric, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(row) == 0 || is.na(row$Rank[[1]])) return("")
    paste0(" (", row$Rank[[1]], " of ", row$Pool[[1]], " D-I teams)")
  }

  off <- pct_of("Runs / Game")
  prev <- pct_of("Run Prevention")
  diff <- pct_of("Run Differential / Game")

  if (is.finite(off) && off >= thresholds$percentile_high) {
    add("HIGH-END SCORING OFFENSE",
        paste0("Scoring rate ranks in the ", round(off),
               "th percentile nationally", rank_text("Runs / Game"), "."),
        "danger")
  }
  if (is.finite(prev) && prev >= thresholds$percentile_high) {
    add("STRONG RUN PREVENTION",
        paste0("Runs allowed ranks in the ", round(prev),
               "th percentile nationally", rank_text("Run Prevention"), "."),
        "strength")
  }
  if (is.finite(diff) && diff >= thresholds$percentile_elite) {
    add("COMPLETE TEAM PROFILE",
        paste0("Run differential per game ranks in the ", round(diff),
               "th percentile nationally", rank_text("Run Differential / Game"), "."),
        "strength")
  }

  if (nrow(team_rates) > 0) {
    r <- team_rates[1, ]
    if (is.finite(r$HR_G) && r$HR_G >= thresholds$hr_per_game) {
      add("POWER THREAT",
          paste0(fmt(r$HR_G, 2), " home runs per game across ", window_label, "."),
          "danger")
    }
    free <- sum(c(r$BB_G, r$HBP_G), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(free) && free >= thresholds$free_bases_per_game) {
      add("FREE-BASE PRESSURE",
          paste0(fmt(free, 1), " walks plus hit-by-pitches per game across ",
                 window_label, "."),
          "danger")
    }
    if (is.finite(r$SB_G) && r$SB_G >= thresholds$sb_per_game) {
      add("ACTIVE RUNNING GAME",
          paste0(fmt(r$SB_G, 2), " stolen bases per game across ", window_label, "."),
          "info")
    }
    if (is.finite(r$SAC_G) && r$SAC_G >= thresholds$sac_per_game) {
      add("BUNT ACTIVITY",
          paste0(fmt(r$SAC_G, 2), " sacrifice hits per game across ", window_label, "."),
          "info")
    }
    if (is.finite(r$K_G) && r$K_G >= thresholds$k_per_game) {
      add("SWING-AND-MISS OPPORTUNITY",
          paste0("The offense is striking out ", fmt(r$K_G, 1),
                 " times per game across ", window_label, "."),
          "opportunity")
    }
  }

  if (nrow(season_metrics) > 0 && nrow(recent_metrics) > 0 &&
      is.finite(season_metrics$WinPct[[1]]) && is.finite(recent_metrics$WinPct[[1]])) {
    delta <- recent_metrics$WinPct[[1]] - season_metrics$WinPct[[1]]
    if (delta >= thresholds$form_swing) {
      add("TRENDING UP",
          "Recent win rate is meaningfully above the full-season baseline.",
          "strength")
    }
    if (delta <= -thresholds$form_swing) {
      add("RECENT COOL-OFF",
          "Recent win rate is meaningfully below the full-season baseline.",
          "opportunity")
    }
  }

  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(flags)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) {
    out <- tibble::tibble(
      Title = "BALANCED PROFILE",
      Body  = "No single tendency cleared the flag thresholds. Prepare to win individual matchups.",
      Type  = "info"
    )
  }
  out
}


# ============================================================
# 19. GAME PLAN
# ============================================================
# Plan language is tied to a named player or a printed number
# wherever the data supports it. Generic coaching filler was
# removed - if the data does not support a point, the plan says
# so instead of manufacturing one.

build_game_plan <- function(percentiles, hitters_ranked, pitchers_ranked,
                            staff_line, bullpen_usage, team_rates,
                            season_metrics, recent_metrics, spray,
                            situational_off, thresholds, window_label,
                            hitter_rank_label = "Top three hitters",
                            pitcher_rank_label = "Top three pitchers") {

  pct_of <- function(metric) {
    if (nrow(percentiles) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    row <- percentiles[percentiles$Metric == metric, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(row) == 0) NA_real_ else row$Percentile[[1]]
  }
  off_pct  <- pct_of("Runs / Game")
  prev_pct <- pct_of("Run Prevention")

  # Top three hitters over the full season.
  col_or_blank <- function(df, nm, default = "") {
    if (nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] else rep(default, nrow(df))
  }

  top_hitter_lines <- if (nrow(hitters_ranked) == 0) {
    "Not enough qualified hitters to rank."
  } else {
    hh <- dplyr::slice_head(hitters_ranked, n = 3)
    hr_txt <- if ("HRText" %in% names(hh)) {
      hh$HRText
    } else {
      paste0(ifelse(is.na(hh$HR), "—", hh$HR), " HR")
    }
    if (any(!is.na(hh$OPS))) {
      paste0(
        hh$Player, " — ", fmt_avg(hh$OPS), " OPS · ",
        fmt_avg(hh$AVG), "/", fmt_avg(hh$OBP), "/", fmt_avg(hh$SLG),
        " · ", hr_txt
      )
    } else {
      paste0(
        hh$Player, " — ", fmt_avg(col_or_blank(hh, "Reach", NA_real_)),
        " reach · ", fmt_avg(col_or_blank(hh, "wAVG", NA_real_)), " AVG · ",
        hr_txt
      )
    }
  }

  # Top three pitchers. Innings are on the line so the sample
  # behind the rate is never hidden.
  top_pitcher_lines <- if (nrow(pitchers_ranked) == 0) {
    "No pitcher has thrown enough innings to rank on rate stats."
  } else {
    pp <- dplyr::slice_head(pitchers_ranked, n = 3)
    ip_part <- if ("IPtxt" %in% names(pp)) paste0(" · ", pp$IPtxt, " IP") else ""
    paste0(
      pp$Player, " — ", fmt(pp$ERA, 2), " ERA · ", fmt(pp$WHIP, 2), " WHIP · ",
      fmt(pp$K9, 1), " K/9", ip_part
    )
  }

  offense_strengths <- character()
  pitcher_counter   <- character()

  if (is.finite(off_pct) && off_pct >= 70) {
    offense_strengths <- c(offense_strengths, paste0(
      "Run production grades in the ", round(off_pct),
      "th percentile nationally."
    ))
    pitcher_counter <- c(pitcher_counter,
      "Make the middle of the order hit with the bases empty. Free traffic in front of them is what turns a single into a crooked number.")
  }

  if (nrow(team_rates) > 0) {
    r <- team_rates[1, ]
    if (is.finite(r$HR_G) && r$HR_G >= thresholds$hr_per_game) {
      offense_strengths <- c(offense_strengths, paste0(
        "Power is real: ", fmt(r$HR_G, 2), " HR per game across ", window_label, "."
      ))
      pitcher_counter <- c(pitcher_counter,
        "With traffic on, prioritize damage prevention over the punchout. Miss down, not over the middle.")
    }
    free <- sum(c(r$BB_G, r$HBP_G), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(free) && free >= 4.0) {
      offense_strengths <- c(offense_strengths, paste0(
        "They reach without the ball in play: ", fmt(free, 1),
        " BB + HBP per game across ", window_label, "."
      ))
      pitcher_counter <- c(pitcher_counter,
        "Win strike one. Their on-base profile is built on counts, not on barrels.")
    }
    if (is.finite(r$SB_G) && r$SB_G >= thresholds$sb_per_game) {
      offense_strengths <- c(offense_strengths, paste0(
        "Active running game: ", fmt(r$SB_G, 2), " stolen bases per game."
      ))
      pitcher_counter <- c(pitcher_counter,
        "Vary looks and hold times with the identified runners on base; get the catcher a chance.")
    }
  }

  # Situational tell: do they hit better or worse with RISP?
  if (nrow(situational_off) > 0) {
    all_row  <- situational_off[situational_off$Split == "All plate appearances", ]
    risp_row <- situational_off[situational_off$Split == "Runners in scoring position", ]
    if (nrow(all_row) == 1 && nrow(risp_row) == 1 &&
        is.finite(all_row$OB) && is.finite(risp_row$OB) && risp_row$PA >= 25) {
      gap <- risp_row$OB - all_row$OB
      if (gap >= 0.04) {
        offense_strengths <- c(offense_strengths, paste0(
          "They get better with runners on: ", fmt_pct(risp_row$OB),
          " on-base with RISP vs ", fmt_pct(all_row$OB), " overall (",
          risp_row$PA, " PA)."
        ))
        pitcher_counter <- c(pitcher_counter,
          "Clean innings matter more than usual against this group. Do not let two-out traffic turn into a rally.")
      } else if (gap <= -0.04) {
        pitcher_counter <- c(pitcher_counter, paste0(
          "They have come up small with runners on (", fmt_pct(risp_row$OB),
          " on-base with RISP vs ", fmt_pct(all_row$OB),
          " overall). Pitching out of traffic is a live option rather than a panic."
        ))
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(offense_strengths) == 0) {
    offense_strengths <- "No single offensive trait cleared the thresholds in this window. Treat the lineup as balanced and attack hitter by hitter."
  }
  if (length(pitcher_counter) == 0) {
    pitcher_counter <- "Win strike one, keep the bases clean, and make their best three hitters beat you without help."
  }

  pitching_strengths <- character()
  pitching_weakness  <- character()
  hitter_attack      <- character()

  staff <- if (nrow(staff_line) > 0) staff_line[1, ] else
    tibble::tibble(ERA = NA_real_, K9 = NA_real_, BB9 = NA_real_)

  if (is.finite(prev_pct) && prev_pct >= 70) {
    pitching_strengths <- c(pitching_strengths, paste0(
      "Run prevention grades in the ", round(prev_pct), "th percentile nationally."
    ))
    hitter_attack <- c(hitter_attack,
      "Scoring chances will be scarce. Do not give away outs once we create traffic.")
  }
  if (is.finite(staff$K9) && staff$K9 >= thresholds$staff_k9_good) {
    pitching_strengths <- c(pitching_strengths, paste0(
      "The staff misses bats: ", fmt(staff$K9, 1), " K/9 across ", window_label, "."
    ))
    hitter_attack <- c(hitter_attack,
      "Shrink the zone with two strikes and make them throw a competitive finish pitch.")
  }
  if (is.finite(staff$WHIP) && staff$WHIP <= thresholds$staff_whip_good) {
    pitching_strengths <- c(pitching_strengths, paste0(
      "They keep the bases clean: ", fmt(staff$WHIP, 2), " WHIP across ",
      window_label, "."
    ))
    hitter_attack <- c(hitter_attack,
      "Traffic will not come for free. Taking the extra base and moving runners matters more than usual.")
  }
  if (is.finite(staff$WHIP) && staff$WHIP >= thresholds$staff_whip_loose) {
    pitching_weakness <- c(pitching_weakness, paste0(
      "They put runners on: ", fmt(staff$WHIP, 2), " WHIP across ", window_label, "."
    ))
    hitter_attack <- c(hitter_attack,
      "Baserunners are there to be had. Keep the line moving and make them pitch out of traffic every inning.")
  }
  if (is.finite(staff$BB9) && staff$BB9 <= thresholds$staff_bb9_good) {
    pitching_strengths <- c(pitching_strengths, paste0(
      "They limit walks: ", fmt(staff$BB9, 1), " BB/9 across ", window_label, "."
    ))
  }
  if (is.finite(staff$BB9) && staff$BB9 >= thresholds$staff_bb9_loose) {
    pitching_weakness <- c(pitching_weakness, paste0(
      "Control is an opening: ", fmt(staff$BB9, 1), " BB/9 across ", window_label, "."
    ))
    hitter_attack <- c(hitter_attack,
      "Control the zone early and make them come back over the plate.")
  }
  if (is.finite(staff$K9) && staff$K9 <= thresholds$staff_k9_soft) {
    pitching_weakness <- c(pitching_weakness, paste0(
      "Not a swing-and-miss staff: ", fmt(staff$K9, 1), " K/9 across ", window_label, "."
    ))
    hitter_attack <- c(hitter_attack,
      "Put the ball in play with intent and make their defense execute repeatedly in an inning.")
  }

  if (nrow(season_metrics) > 0 && nrow(recent_metrics) > 0 &&
      is.finite(season_metrics$RA_G[[1]]) && is.finite(recent_metrics$RA_G[[1]]) &&
      recent_metrics$RA_G[[1]] >= season_metrics$RA_G[[1]] + 0.75) {
    pitching_weakness <- c(pitching_weakness, paste0(
      "Recent run prevention has slipped: ", fmt(recent_metrics$RA_G[[1]], 2),
      " RA/G recently vs ", fmt(season_metrics$RA_G[[1]], 2), " for the season."
    ))
  }

  heavy <- if (nrow(bullpen_usage) > 0 && "Status" %in% names(bullpen_usage)) {
    sum(bullpen_usage$Status %in% c("HEAVY", "WATCH"), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else 0

  if (heavy >= 2) {
    pitching_weakness <- c(pitching_weakness, paste0(
      heavy, " relief arms are carrying elevated recent workload."
    ))
    hitter_attack <- c(hitter_attack,
      "Make the starter work. Getting into the middle-relief portion of this staff early is worth a plan of its own.")
  }

  if (length(pitching_strengths) == 0) {
    pitching_strengths <- "No dominant staff trait cleared the thresholds. Prepare to win individual pitcher matchups."
  }
  if (length(pitching_weakness) == 0) {
    pitching_weakness <- "No statistical weakness cleared the thresholds in this window. The opening is traffic, long at-bats, and forcing them off their preferred usage."
  }
  if (length(hitter_attack) == 0) {
    hitter_attack <- "Control the zone, avoid giving away outs, and create enough traffic to force them into secondary matchups."
  }

  list(
    pitcher_plan = list(
      strengths   = unique(offense_strengths),
      counter     = unique(pitcher_counter),
      top_title   = hitter_rank_label,
      top_players = top_hitter_lines
    ),
    hitter_plan = list(
      strengths   = unique(pitching_strengths),
      weaknesses  = unique(pitching_weakness),
      attack      = unique(hitter_attack),
      top_title   = pitcher_rank_label,
      top_players = top_pitcher_lines
    )
  )
}
```

```{r html_helpers}
# ============================================================
# 20. HTML COMPONENTS
# ============================================================

metric_card <- function(label, value, subtitle = "", source = NULL) {
  src <- if (is.null(source)) "" else
    paste0('<div class="src-tag">', html_escape(source), '</div>')
  paste0(
    '<div class="metric-card">',
      '<div class="metric-label">', html_escape(label), '</div>',
      '<div class="metric-value">', html_escape(value), '</div>',
      '<div class="metric-sub">', html_escape(subtitle), '</div>',
      src,
    '</div>'
  )
}

insight_card <- function(title, body, type = "info", number = NULL) {
  num <- if (is.null(number)) "" else
    paste0('<div class="insight-number">', html_escape(number), '</div>')
  paste0(
    '<div class="insight-card ', html_escape(type), '">', num,
      '<div>',
        '<div class="insight-title">', html_escape(title), '</div>',
        '<div class="insight-body">', html_escape(body), '</div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
}

bullet_list_html <- function(items) {
  if (length(items) == 0) return("")
  paste0("<ul>", paste0("<li>", html_escape(items), "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>")
}

scouting_plan_card <- function(title, strength_title, strengths,
                               response_title, response_items,
                               top_title, top_players,
                               weakness_title = NULL, weaknesses = NULL) {
  weak <- if (is.null(weakness_title) || is.null(weaknesses)) "" else paste0(
    '<div class="plan-subhead">', html_escape(weakness_title), '</div>',
    bullet_list_html(weaknesses)
  )
  paste0(
    '<div class="scouting-plan-card">',
      '<div class="scouting-plan-title">', html_escape(title), '</div>',
      '<div class="plan-subhead">', html_escape(strength_title), '</div>',
      bullet_list_html(strengths), weak,
      '<div class="plan-subhead">', html_escape(response_title), '</div>',
      bullet_list_html(response_items),
      '<div class="plan-subhead">', html_escape(top_title), '</div>',
      '<div class="top-player-list">',
        paste0('<div class="top-player-row">', html_escape(top_players),
               '</div>', collapse = ""),
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
}

list_card <- function(title, subtitle, lines) {
  paste0(
    '<div class="scouting-plan-card">',
      '<div class="scouting-plan-title">', html_escape(title), '</div>',
      '<div class="list-card-sub">', html_escape(subtitle), '</div>',
      '<div class="top-player-list">',
        paste0('<div class="top-player-row">', html_escape(lines), '</div>',
               collapse = ""),
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
}

percentile_card <- function(metric, display, percentile, rank = NA, pool = NA) {
  width <- if (is.na(percentile)) 0 else max(0, min(100, percentile))
  label <- if (is.na(percentile)) {
    "Not enough comparable teams to rank"
  } else if (is.na(rank)) {
    paste0(round(percentile), "th percentile")
  } else {
    paste0(round(percentile), "th percentile · ", rank, " of ", pool, " D-I teams")
  }
  paste0(
    '<div class="percentile-card">',
      '<div class="percentile-top"><span>', html_escape(metric),
        '</span><strong>', html_escape(display), '</strong></div>',
      '<div class="percentile-track"><div class="percentile-fill" style="width:',
        width, '%;"></div></div>',
      '<div class="percentile-foot">', html_escape(label), '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
}

# Horizontal left / center / right distribution bar for spray.
# Vectorized: this is called inside a mutate() over a whole column.
spray_bar <- function(left_pct, center_pct, right_pct) {
  seg <- function(cls, pct) {
    if (is.na(pct) || pct <= 0) return("")
    paste0('<div class="spray-seg ', cls, '" style="width:', round(100 * pct, 1),
           '%;">', round(100 * pct), '</div>')
  }
  mapply(function(l, c_, r) {
    if (is.na(l) && is.na(c_) && is.na(r)) {
      return('<span class="muted-inline">—</span>')
    }
    paste0(
      '<div class="spray-bar">',
        seg("spray-left", l), seg("spray-center", c_), seg("spray-right", r),
      '</div>'
    )
  }, left_pct, center_pct, right_pct, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

source_note <- function(...) {
  paste0('<div class="source-note">', paste0(...), '</div>')
}

callout <- function(...) {
  paste0('<div class="callout">', paste0(...), '</div>')
}

ar_table <- function(df, escape = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(callout("No rows available for this table with the current data."))
  }
  knitr::kable(
    df, format = "html", escape = escape, row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="advance-table"'
  )
}

status_html <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "HEAVY" ~ '<span class="status-heavy">HEAVY</span>',
    x == "WATCH" ~ '<span class="status-watch">WATCH</span>',
    TRUE         ~ '<span class="status-fresh">FRESH</span>'
  )
}

projection_html <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Likely"   ~ '<span class="status-heavy">LIKELY</span>',
    x == "Possible" ~ '<span class="status-watch">POSSIBLE</span>',
    TRUE            ~ '<span class="status-fresh">UNLIKELY</span>'
  )
}
```

```{r pull_schedule}
# ============================================================
# 22. PULL: SCHEDULE, RECORD, FORM
# ============================================================

schedule <- pull_team_schedule(TEAM_ID, SEASON, refresh = REFRESH_DATA)

if (nrow(schedule) == 0) {
  stop(
    "ESPN returned no ", SEASON, " baseball schedule events for ", TEAM_NAME, ".",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

CONFERENCE <- espn_conference(TEAM_ID, SEASON, refresh = REFRESH_DATA)

schedule <- schedule |>
  dplyr::mutate(d1_opponent = opponent_id %in% D1_TEAM_IDS) |>
  mark_conference_games(CONFERENCE$members, TEAM_ID) |>
  add_series_slot()

completed <- schedule |>
  dplyr::filter(completed, !is.na(team_score_num), !is.na(opponent_score_num)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(game_date, game_datetime)

if (nrow(completed) == 0) {
  stop(
    "ESPN returned the ", SEASON, " schedule for ", TEAM_NAME,
    " but no final scores could be parsed. Delete the cache/ folder and Knit ",
    "again with REFRESH_DATA <- TRUE.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

AS_OF_DATE <- max(completed$game_date, na.rm = TRUE)

upcoming <- schedule |>
  dplyr::filter(!completed, !is.na(game_date), game_date > AS_OF_DATE) |>
  dplyr::arrange(game_date, game_datetime)

NEXT_GAME <- if (nrow(upcoming) > 0) {
  upcoming[1, ]
} else {
  tibble::tibble(game_date = AS_OF_DATE + 5, series_slot = NA_real_,
                 opponent_label = NA_character_, home_away = NA_character_)
}
PROJECTION_DATE <- NEXT_GAME$game_date[[1]]

record_string <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return("0-0")
  paste0(
    sum(df$winner_clean %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
    sum(df$winner_clean %in% FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

record_metrics <- function(df, label) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      Window = label, G = 0, W = 0, L = 0,
      WinPct = NA_real_, R_G = NA_real_, RA_G = NA_real_, RD_G = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  g  <- nrow(df)
  rf <- sum(df$team_score_num, na.rm = TRUE)
  ra <- sum(df$opponent_score_num, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble::tibble(
    Window = label,
    G = g,
    W = sum(df$winner_clean %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    L = sum(df$winner_clean %in% FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    WinPct = rate_per(sum(df$winner_clean %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), g),
    R_G  = rate_per(rf, g),
    RA_G = rate_per(ra, g),
    RD_G = rate_per(rf - ra, g)
  )
}

TEAM_RECORD <- record_string(completed)
conference_games <- dplyr::filter(completed, conference_game %in% TRUE)
CONF_RECORD <- if (nrow(conference_games) > 0) record_string(conference_games) else "—"
CONF_NAME   <- CONFERENCE$name %||% NA_character_
CONF_LABEL  <- if (is.na(CONF_NAME)) "Conference" else CONF_NAME

log_check(
  "Conference record",
  if (nrow(conference_games) > 0) "OK" else "UNAVAILABLE",
  if (nrow(conference_games) > 0) {
    paste0(
      CONF_LABEL, ": ", CONF_RECORD, " across ", nrow(conference_games),
      " games. ESPN's schedule feed carries no conference flag for college ",
      "baseball, so conference games are identified by matching the opponent's ",
      "team id against the ", length(CONFERENCE$members),
      " teams in the conference standings - an id comparison, not a name match."
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "No conference games could be identified. ",
      if (length(CONFERENCE$members) == 0) {
        "The conference membership lookup returned nothing for this team."
      } else {
        "Membership resolved but no completed opponent matched it."
      }
    )
  }
)

d1_games     <- dplyr::filter(completed, d1_opponent %in% TRUE)
non_d1_games <- dplyr::filter(completed, !(d1_opponent %in% TRUE))
D1_RECORD    <- record_string(d1_games)
NON_D1_N     <- nrow(non_d1_games)

season_metrics <- record_metrics(completed, "Season")

last_n <- function(df, n) {
  df |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(game_date), dplyr::desc(game_datetime)) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = min(n, nrow(df))) |>
    dplyr::arrange(game_date)
}

last10 <- last_n(completed, RECENT_GAMES)
last5  <- last_n(completed, 5)

recent_metrics <- record_metrics(last10, paste0("Last ", nrow(last10)))
last5_metrics  <- record_metrics(last5,  paste0("Last ", nrow(last5)))
d1_metrics     <- record_metrics(d1_games, "vs Division I")

recent_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  season_metrics, recent_metrics, last5_metrics, d1_metrics
)

  completed, abs(team_score_num - opponent_score_num) == 1
)
ONE_RUN_RECORD <- record_string(one_run_games)

log_check(

  "OK",
  paste0(nrow(completed), " completed games, ", nrow(upcoming), " scheduled ahead.")
)
log_check(
  "Opponent division",
  if (NON_D1_N == 0) "OK" else "NOTE",
  if (NON_D1_N == 0) {
    "Every completed opponent appears in the ESPN Division I team index."
  } else {
    paste0(
      NON_D1_N, " of ", nrow(completed),
      " completed games came against opponents not listed in the ESPN D-I index. ",
      "Season rate stats include those games."
    )
  }
)
```

```{r pull_detail}
# ============================================================
# 23. PULL: DETAILED GAMES + COVERAGE ACCOUNTING
# ============================================================
# Requested games and retrieved games are tracked separately.
# Every window label in the report uses the number of games that
# actually came back, never the number that were asked for.

detail_schedule <- last_n(completed, DETAIL_GAMES)
REQUESTED_GAMES <- nrow(detail_schedule)

progress("ESPN: loading ", nrow(detail_schedule), " game files...")
game_bundles <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(detail_schedule)), function(i) {
  gid <- detail_schedule$event_id[[i]]
  progress("  game ", i, "/", nrow(detail_schedule), " (", gid, ")")
  get_game_bundle(gid, refresh = REFRESH_DATA)
})
names(game_bundles) <- detail_schedule$event_id

component_rows <- function(bundle, component) {
  if (is.null(bundle) || !is.list(bundle) || is.null(names(bundle))) return(0L)
  idx <- which(tolower(names(bundle)) == tolower(component))
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(0L)
  n_rows(bundle[[idx[[1]]]])
}

coverage <- tibble::tibble(
  event_id = detail_schedule$event_id,
  Date     = detail_schedule$game_date,
  Opponent = detail_schedule$opponent_label,
  TeamRows   = vapply(game_bundles, component_rows, integer(1), "Team"),
  PlayerRows = vapply(game_bundles, component_rows, integer(1), "Player"),
  PlayRows   = vapply(game_bundles, component_rows, integer(1), "Plays")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Box = PlayerRows > 0,
    PBP = PlayRows > 0
  )

BOX_GAMES <- sum(coverage$Box)
PBP_GAMES <- sum(coverage$PBP)

WINDOW_LABEL     <- paste0("the last ", BOX_GAMES, " games")
WINDOW_LABEL_CAP <- paste0("Last ", BOX_GAMES, " games")
PBP_LABEL        <- paste0("the last ", PBP_GAMES, " games with play-by-play")

log_check(
  "Box-score coverage",
  if (BOX_GAMES == REQUESTED_GAMES) "OK" else "PARTIAL",
  paste0(BOX_GAMES, " of ", REQUESTED_GAMES,
         " requested games returned a player box score.")
)
log_check(
  "Play-by-play coverage",
  if (PBP_GAMES == REQUESTED_GAMES) "OK" else "PARTIAL",
  paste0(PBP_GAMES, " of ", REQUESTED_GAMES,
         " requested games returned play-by-play.")
)

team_boxes   <- bind_game_component(game_bundles, "Team")
player_boxes <- bind_game_component(game_bundles, "Player")
plays_raw    <- bind_game_component(game_bundles, "Plays")

# Resolve player identity once, before anything is grouped, so the
# same person cannot appear twice under two spellings or two ids.
identity_map <- build_identity_map(player_boxes)

bat_rows <- espn_batting_rows(player_boxes, TEAM_ID, identity_map)
pit_rows <- espn_pitching_rows(player_boxes, TEAM_ID, identity_map)

merged_ids   <- if (nrow(identity_map) == 0) 0L else
  sum(identity_map$id_variants > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
merged_names <- if (nrow(identity_map) == 0) 0L else
  sum(identity_map$name_variants > 1, na.rm = TRUE)

log_check(
  "Player identity",
  if (merged_ids == 0 && merged_names == 0) "OK" else "MERGED",
  if (merged_ids == 0 && merged_names == 0) {
    "Every player appeared under one id and one spelling across the window."
  } else {
    paste0(
      merged_names, " players appeared under more than one spelling of their ",
      "name (usually a middle initial present in some box scores and not ",
      "others) and ", merged_ids, " under more than one ESPN athlete id. ",
      "Those were merged into one player before any totals were computed, so ",
      "the same person is not split across two rows."
    )
  }
)

# Roster lookup used to attribute play-by-play events. Both teams
# are included so an opposing fielder's name can never be mistaken
# for the player who did the thing.
roster <- if (nrow(identity_map) == 0) tibble::tibble() else {
  identity_map |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      athlete_id = canonical_id,
      Player,
      team_id,
      key
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(key), !is.na(athlete_id)) |>
    dplyr::distinct(athlete_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

dup_keys <- if (nrow(roster) == 0) 0L else sum(duplicated(roster$key))
if (nrow(roster) > 0) {
  roster <- dplyr::distinct(roster, key, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
log_check(
  "Player name keys unique",
  if (dup_keys == 0) "OK" else "NOTE",
  if (dup_keys == 0) {
    "No name collisions between the two rosters in this window."
  } else {
    paste0(
      dup_keys, " players on opposing rosters normalize to the same name; ",
      "the first was kept. Play-by-play attribution for those players may be shared."
    )
  }
)
```

```{r pull_ncaa}
# ============================================================
# 24. PULL: NCAA SEASON STATS + RECONCILIATION
# ============================================================

ncaa_batting  <- tibble::tibble()
ncaa_pitching <- tibble::tibble()
NCAA_TEAM_NAME <- NA_character_
NCAA_OK <- FALSE

NCAA_BUDGET_HIT <- FALSE
NCAA_NO_ID      <- FALSE
NCAA_ID_SOURCE  <- ""

if (isTRUE(USE_NCAA)) {
  ncaa_started <- Sys.time()
  budget_left  <- function() {
    as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), ncaa_started, units = "secs")) <
      NCAA_BUDGET_SECONDS
  }

  # A working id, once found, is remembered. Nothing below has to
  # run again on later renders for the same team and season.
  id_key <- c("ncaa_working_id", slugify(TEAM_QUERY), SEASON, NCAA_DIVISION)
  sticky <- if (isTRUE(REFRESH_DATA)) NULL else cache_peek(id_key)

  candidates <- character()
  cand_note  <- ""

  if (!is.na(NCAA_TEAM_ID) && nzchar(NCAA_TEAM_ID)) {
    candidates <- as.character(NCAA_TEAM_ID)
    cand_note  <- "id set in the settings block"
    progress("NCAA: using the team id from the settings block")
  } else if (!is.null(sticky) && nzchar(sticky)) {
    candidates <- sticky
    cand_note  <- "id remembered from an earlier render"
    progress("NCAA: reusing the team id that worked last time")
  } else {
    progress("NCAA: looking up the team id...")
    found <- ncaa_candidate_ids(
      TEAM_QUERY, TEAM_NAME, TEAM_ABBREV, SEASON, NCAA_DIVISION,
      allow_scrape = NCAA_ALLOW_INDEX_SCRAPE, refresh = REFRESH_DATA
    )
    candidates     <- found$ids
    NCAA_TEAM_NAME <- found$name
    cand_note <- if (length(found$sources) == 0) "" else
      paste(unique(found$sources), collapse = ", ")
    progress("NCAA: ", length(candidates), " candidate id(s) found")
  }

  NCAA_ID_SOURCE <- cand_note

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    NCAA_NO_ID <- TRUE
  } else {
    ncaa_id <- NA_character_
    for (cand in candidates) {
      if (!budget_left()) {
        NCAA_BUDGET_HIT <- TRUE
        break
      }
      progress("NCAA: trying season batting for id ", cand, "...")
      attempt <- build_ncaa_batting(
        pull_ncaa_stats(cand, SEASON, "batting", REFRESH_DATA)
      )
      if (nrow(attempt) > 0) {
        ncaa_batting <- attempt
        ncaa_id <- cand
        break
      }
    }

    if (!is.na(ncaa_id) && budget_left()) {
      progress("NCAA: pulling season pitching...")
      ncaa_pitching <- build_ncaa_pitching(
        pull_ncaa_stats(ncaa_id, SEASON, "pitching", REFRESH_DATA)
      )
    }

    NCAA_OK <- nrow(ncaa_batting) > 0

    if (NCAA_OK) {
      cache_poke(id_key, ncaa_id)
    } else if (!NCAA_BUDGET_HIT) {
      # A remembered id that stops working is worse than none.
      cache_forget(id_key)
    }
  }

  progress(
    "NCAA: finished in ",
    round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), ncaa_started, units = "secs"))),
    "s (", if (NCAA_OK) "ok" else "unavailable", ")"
  )
}

log_check(
  "NCAA official stats",
  if (!isTRUE(USE_NCAA)) "SKIPPED" else if (NCAA_OK) "OK" else "UNAVAILABLE",
  if (!isTRUE(USE_NCAA)) {
    "USE_NCAA is FALSE. Season rate stats fall back to ESPN season-to-date values."
  } else if (NCAA_OK) {
    paste0("Matched to '", NCAA_TEAM_NAME, "'",
           if (nzchar(NCAA_ID_SOURCE)) paste0(" via ", NCAA_ID_SOURCE) else "",
           ". ", nrow(ncaa_batting), " hitters and ", nrow(ncaa_pitching),
           " pitchers loaded.")
  } else if (NCAA_NO_ID) {
    paste0(
      "No stats.ncaa.org team id could be found for '", TEAM_QUERY,
      "' in the lookup tables bundled with baseballr, and the live index ",
      "scrape is switched off because it takes minutes and frequently times ",
      "out. To turn this section on, open the team on stats.ncaa.org, copy the ",
      "number from the URL, and set NCAA_TEAM_ID in the settings block. Season ",
      "slash lines meanwhile come from ESPN's season-to-date snapshot, which is ",
      "a snapshot, not an official total."
    )
  } else if (NCAA_BUDGET_HIT) {
    paste0(
      "The NCAA pull exceeded its ", NCAA_BUDGET_SECONDS, "-second budget and was ",
      "cut short so the render could finish. stats.ncaa.org throttles heavily. ",
      "Season slash lines fall back to the most recent ESPN season-to-date value, ",
      "which is a snapshot, not an official total. Re-knitting usually succeeds, ",
      "and once it does the result is cached."
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "stats.ncaa.org did not return usable data. Season slash lines fall back ",
      "to the most recent ESPN season-to-date value, which is a snapshot, not ",
      "an official total."
    )
  }
)

# ESPN carries a running season-to-date slash line in each box
# score. Comparing the last one against the official NCAA totals
# is a direct test of whether the two sources agree.
espn_std <- if (nrow(bat_rows) == 0) tibble::tibble() else {
  bat_rows |>
    dplyr::arrange(athlete_id, game_date) |>
    dplyr::group_by(athlete_id, Player) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      e_avg = last_non_na(std_avg),
      e_obp = last_non_na(std_obp),
      e_slg = last_non_na(std_slg),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(key = norm_person_key(Player))
}

reconciliation <- tibble::tibble()
if (NCAA_OK && nrow(espn_std) > 0) {
  reconciliation <- espn_std |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      dplyr::select(ncaa_batting, key, n_avg = AVG, n_obp = OBP, n_slg = SLG, n_pa = PA),
      by = "key"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_avg = abs(e_avg - n_avg),
      d_obp = abs(e_obp - n_obp),
      d_slg = abs(e_slg - n_slg),
      MaxGap = pmax(d_avg, d_obp, d_slg, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(MaxGap))

  matched   <- nrow(reconciliation)
  unmatched <- nrow(espn_std) - matched
  big_gaps  <- sum(reconciliation$MaxGap > 0.030, na.rm = TRUE)

  log_check(
    "ESPN vs NCAA slash lines",
    if (big_gaps == 0) "OK" else "REVIEW",
    paste0(
      matched, " hitters matched by name (", unmatched, " unmatched). ",
      big_gaps, " differ by more than 30 points on at least one rate stat. ",
      "The report uses the NCAA figure where the two disagree."
    )
  )
}
```

```{r build_tables}
# ============================================================
# 25. BUILD: DERIVED TABLES
# ============================================================

batting_window  <- build_batting_window(bat_rows, WINDOW_LABEL_CAP)
pitching_window <- build_pitching_window(pit_rows, WINDOW_LABEL_CAP)
expected_lineup <- build_expected_lineup(bat_rows)

rotation_projection <- build_rotation_projection(pit_rows, completed, NEXT_GAME)
bullpen_usage       <- build_bullpen_usage(pit_rows, AS_OF_DATE)
role_splits         <- pitcher_role_splits(pit_rows, completed)
workload            <- starter_workload(pit_rows)

team_rate_out <- build_team_rates(team_boxes, TEAM_ID)
team_rates    <- team_rate_out$rates

if (nzchar(team_rate_out$missing)) {
  log_check(
    "Team box-score fields",
    "PARTIAL",
    paste0("Not published by ESPN for these games: ", team_rate_out$missing,
           ". Those rows show a dash rather than a zero.")
  )
}

# Window-level staff line, computed from summed counting stats.
staff_line <- if (nrow(pit_rows) == 0) {
  tibble::tibble(IP = NA_real_, ERA = NA_real_, WHIP = NA_real_,
                 K9 = NA_real_, BB9 = NA_real_)
} else {
  outs <- sum(pit_rows$Outs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ip   <- outs_to_ip_num(outs)
  tibble::tibble(
    IP   = ip,
    ERA  = rate_per(sum(pit_rows$ER, na.rm = TRUE), ip, 9),
    WHIP = rate_per(
      sum(pit_rows$BB, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(pit_rows$H, na.rm = TRUE), ip
    ),
    K9   = rate_per(sum(pit_rows$K,  na.rm = TRUE), ip, 9),
    BB9  = rate_per(sum(pit_rows$BB, na.rm = TRUE), ip, 9)
  )
}

# ---- Play-by-play derived ---------------------------------
events     <- parse_pbp(plays_raw, TEAM_ID, roster, completed)
run_ledger <- build_run_ledger(plays_raw, TEAM_ID, completed)

spray            <- build_spray(events, TEAM_ID)
hitter_splits    <- build_hitter_splits(events)
situational_off  <- build_team_situational(events, "offense")
situational_def  <- build_team_situational(events, "defense")
running_game     <- build_running_game(events, PBP_GAMES)
coverage_pbp     <- pbp_coverage(events)

# Internal consistency test: runs recovered from the play text
# against the final scores ESPN reported for the same games.
pbp_runs_check <- tibble::tibble()
if (nrow(run_ledger) > 0) {
  pbp_runs <- run_ledger |>
    dplyr::group_by(game_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(PBP_Runs = sum(FocalRuns, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  pbp_runs_check <- completed |>
    dplyr::select(game_id = event_id, Box_Runs = team_score_num) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(pbp_runs, by = "game_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Match = PBP_Runs == Box_Runs)

  if (nrow(pbp_runs_check) > 0) {
    agree <- mean(pbp_runs_check$Match, na.rm = TRUE)
    log_check(
      "Scoreboard reconstruction",
      if (agree >= 0.95) "OK" else if (agree >= 0.80) "REVIEW" else "POOR",
      paste0(
        "Runs rebuilt from the play-by-play scoreboard match the final score in ",
        fmt_pct(agree), " of ", nrow(pbp_runs_check),
        " games. This is what the Scoring by Inning chart is built from."
      )
    )
  }
}

# A separate and genuinely independent test: how many of the runs
# actually scored are NAMED in the play text. This does not touch
# the score columns, so it cannot validate itself against the check
# above - it measures whether the text parser is seeing the game.
# It is expected to fall short of 100%: a run scored on a wild pitch
# or a balk is written under the pitcher's name, not the runner's.
TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY <- NA_real_
if (nrow(events) > 0 && "text_runs" %in% names(events)) {
  text_runs_by_game <- events |>
    dplyr::filter(is_focal) |>
    dplyr::group_by(game_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(TextRuns = sum(text_runs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  text_cmp <- completed |>
    dplyr::select(game_id = event_id, Box_Runs = team_score_num) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(text_runs_by_game, by = "game_id")

  if (nrow(text_cmp) > 0 && sum(text_cmp$Box_Runs, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY <- sum(text_cmp$TextRuns, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(text_cmp$Box_Runs, na.rm = TRUE)

    log_check(
      "Runs named in the play text",
      if (is.finite(TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY) && TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY >= 0.90) "OK"
      else if (is.finite(TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY) && TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY >= 0.75) "REVIEW"
      else "POOR",
      paste0(
        "The play text accounts for ", fmt_pct(TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY),
        " of the runs this team actually scored across ", nrow(text_cmp),
        " games. This is the real test of the text parse that the Spray & ",
        "Splits tab depends on - falling a little short is normal, since runs ",
        "scored on a wild pitch or balk are written under the pitcher's name."
      )
    )
  }
}

# ---- Master hitter table ----------------------------------
hitters <- batting_window |>
  dplyr::mutate(key = norm_person_key(Player))

if (NCAA_OK) {
  hitters <- hitters |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      ncaa_batting |>
        dplyr::select(key, s_G = G, s_PA = PA, s_AB = AB, s_AVG = AVG,
                      s_OBP = OBP, s_SLG = SLG, s_OPS = OPS, s_ISO = ISO,
                      s_HR = HR, s_BB = BB, s_K = K, s_SB = SB, s_CS = CS,
                      s_BBpct = BBpct, s_Kpct = Kpct, s_Yr = Yr, s_Pos = NPos),
      by = "key"
    )
} else {
  hitters <- hitters |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::select(espn_std, key, s_AVG = e_avg, s_OBP = e_obp, s_SLG = e_slg),
      by = "key"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      s_G = NA_real_, s_PA = NA_real_, s_AB = NA_real_,
      s_OPS = s_OBP + s_SLG, s_ISO = s_SLG - s_AVG,
      s_HR = NA_real_, s_BB = NA_real_, s_K = NA_real_,
      s_SB = NA_real_, s_CS = NA_real_,
      s_BBpct = NA_real_, s_Kpct = NA_real_,
      s_Yr = NA_character_, s_Pos = NA_character_
    )
}

# Season list: full-season production, ranked on OPS. Qualifying
# is season plate appearances; if there is no official season line
# the whole window stands in for it and the card says so.
hitters <- dplyr::mutate(
  hitters,
  Qualified = tidyr::replace_na(
    if (NCAA_OK) !is.na(s_PA) & s_PA >= MIN_PA_SEASON else AB >= MIN_AB_WINDOW,
    FALSE
  )
)

hitters_ranked <- hitters |>
  dplyr::filter(Qualified) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    AVG = s_AVG, OBP = s_OBP, SLG = s_SLG, OPS = s_OPS,
    # Home runs are the one counting stat on this card, and without
    # the NCAA feed the only figure available is the window total.
    # It is shown with its window attached rather than sitting
    # unlabelled next to a season slash line.
    HRText = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(s_HR),
      paste0(HR, " HR (last ", BOX_GAMES, ")"),
      paste0(s_HR, " HR")
    ),
    HR = dplyr::coalesce(s_HR, HR),
    Kpct = dplyr::coalesce(s_Kpct, Kpct),
    SortKey = dplyr::coalesce(s_OPS, Reach)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(SortKey))

# The label has to describe the numbers actually printed. When the
# NCAA feed is down the slash line is still a SEASON figure - ESPN's
# running season-to-date snapshot - so calling it "last 16 games"
# was wrong in the one direction that matters.
SEASON_SLASH_SOURCE <- dplyr::case_when(
  NCAA_OK ~ "NCAA official season totals",
  any(!is.na(hitters_ranked$OPS)) ~ "ESPN season-to-date snapshot",
  TRUE ~ "recent window only"
)

HITTER_RANK_LABEL <- if (NCAA_OK) {
  paste0("Top three hitters — season OPS, ", MIN_PA_SEASON, "+ PA")
} else if (any(!is.na(hitters_ranked$OPS))) {
  "Top three hitters — season-to-date OPS (ESPN snapshot, not official)"
} else {
  paste0("Top three hitters — last ", BOX_GAMES, " games, no season line available")
}

# ---- Master pitcher table ---------------------------------
pitchers <- pitching_window |>
  dplyr::mutate(key = norm_person_key(Player))

if (nrow(ncaa_pitching) > 0) {
  pitchers <- pitchers |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      ncaa_pitching |>
        dplyr::select(key, s_App = App, s_GS = GS, s_IP = IP, s_ERA = ERA,
                      s_K9 = K9, s_BB9 = BB9, s_H9 = H9, s_KBB = KBB,
                      s_WHIP = WHIP, s_K = K, s_BB = BB),
      by = "key"
    )
} else {
  pitchers <- pitchers |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      s_App = NA_real_, s_GS = NA_real_, s_IP = NA_real_, s_ERA = NA_real_,
      s_K9 = NA_real_, s_BB9 = NA_real_, s_H9 = NA_real_, s_KBB = NA_real_,
      s_WHIP = NA_real_, s_K = NA_real_, s_BB = NA_real_
    )
}

# Innings qualifier, scaled to games played. Season innings are
# measured against the team's completed games; when there is no
# season line the window is measured against the games in it.
PITCHER_QUAL_SEASON <- max(
  PITCHER_QUAL_IP_FLOOR, PITCHER_QUAL_IP_PER_GAME * nrow(completed)
)
PITCHER_QUAL_WINDOW <- max(3, PITCHER_QUAL_IP_PER_GAME * BOX_GAMES)

pitchers <- pitchers |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    RankIP  = dplyr::coalesce(s_IP, IPnum),
    QualBar = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(s_IP), PITCHER_QUAL_SEASON, PITCHER_QUAL_WINDOW)
  )

# If fewer than three arms clear the bar, halve it once rather than
# print a one-man list. The card reports which bar was used.
PITCHER_QUAL_RELAXED <- sum(pitchers$RankIP >= pitchers$QualBar, na.rm = TRUE) < 3
if (PITCHER_QUAL_RELAXED) {
  pitchers$QualBar <- pitchers$QualBar / 2
}

pitchers <- dplyr::mutate(
  pitchers,
  Qualified = tidyr::replace_na(RankIP >= QualBar, FALSE)
)

pitchers_ranked <- pitchers |>
  dplyr::filter(Qualified %in% TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ERA  = dplyr::coalesce(s_ERA, ERA),
    WHIP = dplyr::coalesce(s_WHIP, WHIP),
    K9   = dplyr::coalesce(s_K9, K9),
    BB9  = dplyr::coalesce(s_BB9, BB9),
    IPtxt = outs_to_ip_chr(round(RankIP * 3))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(ERA, WHIP, dplyr::desc(K9))

PITCHER_QUAL_USED <- if (nrow(pitchers) == 0) NA_real_ else
  suppressWarnings(min(pitchers$QualBar, na.rm = TRUE))

PITCHER_USES_SEASON <- any(!is.na(pitchers$s_IP))

PITCHER_RANK_LABEL <- if (!is.finite(PITCHER_QUAL_USED)) {
  "Top three pitchers — ERA and WHIP"
} else {
  paste0(
    "Top three pitchers — ",
    if (PITCHER_USES_SEASON) "season" else paste0("last ", BOX_GAMES, " games"),
    ", ERA and WHIP, ", fmt(PITCHER_QUAL_USED, 0), "+ IP",
    if (PITCHER_QUAL_RELAXED) " (bar lowered)" else ""
  )
}

# ---- Recent performers: a separate, shorter window ---------
recent_perf_games <- coverage |>
  dplyr::filter(Box) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Date)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = RECENT_PERF_GAMES)

RECENT_PERF_N <- nrow(recent_perf_games)
RECENT_PERF_RANGE <- if (RECENT_PERF_N == 0) "" else {
  paste0(
    format(min(recent_perf_games$Date), "%b %d"), " – ",
    format(max(recent_perf_games$Date), "%b %d")
  )
}

recent_hitters  <- build_recent_hitters(
  bat_rows, recent_perf_games$event_id, MIN_AB_RECENT
)
recent_pitchers <- build_recent_pitchers(
  pit_rows, recent_perf_games$event_id, MIN_OUT_RECENT
)

RECENT_HITTER_LINES <- if (nrow(recent_hitters) == 0) {
  paste0("No hitter reached ", MIN_AB_RECENT, " at-bats in this window.")
} else {
  rh <- dplyr::slice_head(recent_hitters, n = 3)
  paste0(
    rh$Player, " — ", fmt_avg(rh$Reach), " reach · ", fmt_avg(rh$AVG), " AVG · ",
    rh$HR, " HR · ", rh$RBI, " RBI · ", rh$H, "-for-", rh$AB
  )
}

RECENT_PITCHER_LINES <- if (nrow(recent_pitchers) == 0) {
  paste0("No pitcher recorded ", MIN_OUT_RECENT, " outs in this window.")
} else {
  rp <- dplyr::slice_head(recent_pitchers, n = 3)
  paste0(
    rp$Player, " — ", fmt(rp$ERA, 2), " ERA · ", fmt(rp$WHIP, 2), " WHIP · ",
    fmt(rp$K9, 1), " K/9 · ", rp$IP, " IP"
  )
}

RECENT_SUBTITLE <- paste0(
  "Last ", RECENT_PERF_N, " games",
  if (nzchar(RECENT_PERF_RANGE)) paste0(" · ", RECENT_PERF_RANGE) else "",
  ". Small samples on purpose — at-bats and innings are on every line."
)

RANK_METHOD_NOTE <- paste0(
  "<strong>Season source: ", SEASON_SLASH_SOURCE, ".</strong> ",
  if (!NCAA_OK) {
    paste0(
      "The official NCAA totals were unavailable for this render, so the season ",
      "slash line is ESPN's running season-to-date value and home runs are the ",
      "recent-window total, marked as such on each line. "
    )
  } else "",
  "<strong>Season lists.</strong> Hitters are ranked on season OPS and need ",
  MIN_PA_SEASON, "+ plate appearances. Pitchers are ranked on ERA, then WHIP, ",
  "and must have thrown ", fmt(PITCHER_QUAL_USED, 0), "+ innings",
  if (PITCHER_QUAL_RELAXED) {
    " — the bar was halved because fewer than three arms cleared the full one"
  } else {
    paste0(" (", PITCHER_QUAL_IP_PER_GAME, " per team game)")
  },
  ", so a four-inning cameo cannot lead the staff on rate stats. ",
  "<strong>Recent lists.</strong> The same three-deep view over the last ",
  RECENT_PERF_N, " games only, ranked on reach rate for hitters (",
  MIN_AB_RECENT, "+ AB) and ERA then WHIP for pitchers (", MIN_OUT_RECENT,
  "+ outs). These are small samples by design — they answer who is going well ",
  "right now, not who is good — so the at-bats and innings behind each rate are ",
  "printed on the line. Read them next to the season lists, not instead of them."
)

# ---- Percentiles, flags, plan ------------------------------
d1_baseline  <- build_d1_baseline(SEASON, refresh = REFRESH_DATA)
d1_team_row  <- find_team_in_baseline(d1_baseline, TEAM_QUERY, TEAM_NAME, TEAM_ABBREV)
percentiles  <- build_percentile_table(d1_baseline, d1_team_row)

log_check(
  "National baseline",
  if (nrow(percentiles) > 0) "OK" else "UNAVAILABLE",
  if (nrow(percentiles) > 0) {
    paste0("Compared against ", percentiles$Pool[[1]],
           " teams in the ESPN Division I standings feed.")
  } else {
    "The team could not be matched in the standings feed, so no national percentiles are shown."
  }
)

flags <- build_flags(
  season_metrics, recent_metrics, team_rates, percentiles,
  THRESHOLDS, WINDOW_LABEL
)

game_plan <- build_game_plan(
  percentiles, hitters_ranked, pitchers_ranked, staff_line, bullpen_usage,
  team_rates, season_metrics, recent_metrics, spray, situational_off,
  THRESHOLDS, WINDOW_LABEL,
  hitter_rank_label  = HITTER_RANK_LABEL,
  pitcher_rank_label = PITCHER_RANK_LABEL
)

recent_results <- completed |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(game_date)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = min(10, nrow(completed))) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Date     = format(game_date, "%b %d"),
    Opponent = opponent_label,
    Site = dplyr::case_when(
      neutral_site %in% TRUE ~ "N",
      stringr::str_to_lower(home_away) == "home" ~ "H",
      TRUE ~ "A"
    ),
    Slot   = slot_label,
    Result = ifelse(winner_clean %in% TRUE, "W", "L"),
    Score  = paste0(team_score_num, "-", opponent_score_num),
    Conf   = ifelse(conference_game %in% TRUE, "Yes", "—"),
    `D-I`  = ifelse(d1_opponent, "Yes", "No")
  )

season_row <- season_metrics[1, ]
recent_row <- recent_metrics[1, ]

logo_html <- if (!is.na(LOGO_URI)) {
  paste0('<img class="hero-logo" src="', LOGO_URI, '" alt="',
         html_escape(TEAM_NAME), ' logo">')
} else {
  paste0('<div class="hero-monogram">', html_escape(TEAM_ABBREV), '</div>')
}
```

```{r css, results='asis'}
# ============================================================
# 26. STYLE
# ============================================================
# The report no longer relies on Bootstrap. The previous build
# set theme: null, which strips Bootstrap out of the template -
# and the .tabset feature and .nav-tabs / .main-container styling
# it used all depend on Bootstrap being there. The tabs and the
# page container silently did nothing. Everything below is
# self-contained, so the knitted .html renders identically for
# anyone who opens it, offline, with no CDN.

cat(paste0('
<style>
:root {
  --team-primary: ', PRIMARY_COLOR, ';
  --team-secondary: ', SECONDARY_COLOR, ';
  --team-primary-text: ', PRIMARY_TEXT, ';
  --team-secondary-text: ', SECONDARY_TEXT, ';
  --ink: #18232D;
  --muted: #697783;
  --background: #EDF1F4;
  --soft: #F6F8FA;
  --line: #E1E6EA;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --danger: #A13C35;
  --strength: #306B55;
  --opportunity: #896718;
}

html, body {
  background: var(--background);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.ar-shell {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 28px auto 60px auto;
  background: var(--white);
  padding: 0 42px 48px 42px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 42px rgba(28, 42, 54, .09);
  overflow: hidden;
}

h1 { display: none; }

h2 {
  font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink);
  margin: 30px 0 14px 0;
}

h3 {
  font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink);
  margin: 26px 0 10px 0;
}

.hero {
  margin: 0 -42px 22px -42px;
  padding: 40px 52px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    122deg,
    var(--team-primary) 0%, var(--team-primary) 73%,
    var(--team-secondary) 73%, var(--team-secondary) 100%
  );
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-logo-box {
  width: 140px; height: 140px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.97);
  border-radius: 22px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}
.hero-logo { max-width: 112px; max-height: 112px; object-fit: contain; }
.hero-monogram { font-size: 38px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--team-primary); }

.hero-kicker {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.8px;
  text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 7px;
}
.hero-title {
  color: var(--team-primary-text);
  font-size: 40px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px;
  line-height: 1.04; margin-bottom: 9px;
}
.hero-subtitle {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600;
}
.hero-meta {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 6px;
}

/* ---- Tabs (no Bootstrap, no jQuery) ---- */
.tabbar {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.tabbtn {
  appearance: none; background: transparent; border: none;
  border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
  color: #677581; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px;
  padding: 12px 15px; cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
}
.tabbtn:hover { color: var(--team-primary); }
.tabbtn.is-active {
  color: var(--team-primary);
  border-bottom-color: var(--team-secondary);
}
.ar-panel.is-hidden { display: none; }

.section-kicker {
  color: var(--team-primary); text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 1.4px; margin-top: 8px;
}
.section-title {
  color: var(--ink); font-size: 25px; font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -.4px; margin: 3px 0 15px 0;
}

.metric-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 11px; margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.metric-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 4px solid var(--team-secondary);
  border-radius: 11px; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 15px; min-height: 112px;
}
.metric-label {
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .8px;
}
.metric-value {
  color: var(--team-primary); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1; margin-top: 10px;
}
.metric-sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.35; margin-top: 7px; }
.src-tag {
  margin-top: 8px; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .6px;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: #94A2AD; font-weight: 700;
}

.insight-stack { display: grid; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.insight-card {
  display: flex; gap: 13px; align-items: flex-start; background: #FFFFFF;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 5px solid var(--team-primary);
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px;
}
.insight-card.danger { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.insight-card.strength { border-left-color: var(--strength); }
.insight-card.opportunity { border-left-color: var(--opportunity); }
.insight-number {
  flex: 0 0 30px; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--team-primary); color: var(--team-primary-text);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 900; font-size: 12px;
}
.insight-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.insight-body { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; }

.two-column {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px; align-items: start;
}
.three-column {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 15px; align-items: start;
}

.scouting-plan-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 5px solid var(--team-primary);
  border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 18px 20px; min-height: 100%;
}
.scouting-plan-title {
  color: var(--team-primary); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 900;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .5px; margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.plan-subhead {
  color: var(--ink); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .8px; margin: 16px 0 7px 0;
}
.scouting-plan-card ul { margin: 0 0 4px 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.scouting-plan-card li { color: #4F5C67; line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 7px; }

.list-card-sub {
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.top-player-list { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.top-player-row {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--soft);
  padding: 8px 10px; color: #45535E; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px;
}

.callout {
  background: var(--soft); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 13px 15px; color: #53616D; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.source-note {
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5;
  margin: -8px 0 20px 0;
}
.muted-inline { color: var(--muted); }

.advance-table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 8px 0 22px 0; font-size: 12px;
}
.advance-table thead th {
  background: var(--team-primary); color: var(--team-primary-text);
  border: none !important; padding: 10px 9px !important;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .4px; text-align: left;
}
.advance-table tbody td {
  padding: 9px !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  vertical-align: middle !important;
}
.advance-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #FAFBFC; }
.table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }

.percentile-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 13px; margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.percentile-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 11px; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px;
}
.percentile-top {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 9px;
}
.percentile-top strong { color: var(--team-primary); }
.percentile-track, .probability-track {
  height: 8px; background: #E9EDF1; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;
}
.percentile-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--team-secondary); }
.percentile-foot { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; margin-top: 7px; }

.status-heavy { color: #A13C35; font-weight: 900; }
.status-watch { color: #896718; font-weight: 900; }
.status-fresh { color: #306B55; font-weight: 900; }

/* ---- Spray distribution bar ---- */
.spray-bar {
  display: flex; width: 150px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.spray-seg {
  color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 0;
}
.spray-left { background: var(--team-primary); }
.spray-center { background: #8B9AA6; }
.spray-right { background: var(--team-secondary); color: var(--team-secondary-text); }
.spray-key { display: flex; gap: 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.spray-key span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.spray-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block; }

.inning-chart {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(9, minmax(42px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px; align-items: end; min-height: 250px;
  padding: 20px 14px 10px 14px; margin: 8px 0 6px 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, #FFFFFF, #FAFBFC);
}
.inning-column {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;
  align-items: center; min-width: 0;
}
.inning-value { color: var(--team-primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.inning-bar-wrap {
  width: 100%; height: 185px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.inning-bar {
  width: 68%; min-height: 3px; border-radius: 7px 7px 0 0;
  background: var(--team-primary);
}
.inning-label { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.inning-caption {
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 20px; text-align: center;
}

/* ---- Data quality ---- */
.dq-grid { display: grid; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.dq-row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr; gap: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px 14px;
  background: #FFFFFF; align-items: start;
}
.dq-badge {
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .5px;
  text-align: center; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 5px;
}
.dq-ok { background: #E4F0EA; color: #24614A; }
.dq-note { background: #FBF2DC; color: #7A5B12; }
.dq-bad { background: #F7E3E1; color: #8E332C; }
.dq-title { font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.dq-detail { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; }

.footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); text-align: center;
  font-size: 10px; margin-top: 40px; padding-top: 18px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .ar-shell { margin: 0; padding: 0 18px 40px 18px; border-radius: 0; }
  .hero {
    margin: 0 -18px 20px -18px; padding: 26px 22px;
    grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .hero-logo-box { width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 15px; }
  .hero-logo { max-width: 68px; max-height: 68px; }
  .hero-title { font-size: 26px; }
  .metric-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .two-column, .three-column, .percentile-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

@media print {
  .tabbar { display: none; }
  /* every tab is expanded, so a printed copy is the whole report */
  .ar-panel.is-hidden { display: block !important; }
  .ar-shell { box-shadow: none; margin: 0; max-width: none; padding: 0 12px; }
  body { background: #FFFFFF; }

  /* keep the team colours in the PDF rather than printing white */
  html, body {
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
  }

  /* one section per page, and never split a card down the middle */
  .ar-panel { break-before: page; page-break-before: always; }
  .ar-panel:first-of-type { break-before: auto; page-break-before: auto; }
  .hero { break-after: avoid; page-break-after: avoid; }
  .metric-card, .insight-card, .scouting-plan-card, .percentile-card,
  .threat-card, .dq-row, .inning-chart {
    break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid;
  }
  .advance-table tr { break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid; }
  .advance-table thead { display: table-header-group; }
  .table-scroll { overflow: visible; }
  h2, h3 { break-after: avoid; page-break-after: avoid; }
}
</style>
'))
```

```{r shell_and_hero, results='asis'}
AR_TABS <- c(
  overview = "Overview",
  hitters  = "Hitters",

panel_close <- function() cat('</div>')

  '<section class="hero">',
    '<div class="hero-logo-box">', logo_html, '</div>',
    '<div>',

      '<div class="hero-title">', html_escape(TEAM_NAME), '</div>',
      '<div class="hero-subtitle">',

        if (CONF_RECORD == "—") "" else
          paste0(' · ', html_escape(CONF_LABEL), ' ', CONF_RECORD),

      '</div>',

        'Season data through ', format(AS_OF_DATE, "%B %d, %Y"), ' · ',
```

```{r tab_script, results='asis'}
# Tabs are plain DOM. Panels start visible so that a browser
# with JavaScript disabled - and the print stylesheet - still
# show the whole report rather than one section.
cat('
<script>
(function () {
  function activate(id) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".ar-panel").forEach(function (p) {
      p.classList.toggle("is-hidden", p.id !== id);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".tabbtn").forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle("is-active", b.dataset.panel === id);
    });
  }
  function init() {
    var buttons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".tabbtn"));
    if (!buttons.length) return;
    buttons.forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { activate(b.dataset.panel); });
    });
    activate(buttons[0].dataset.panel);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
')
```

```{r five_things, results='asis'}
five <- dplyr::slice_head(flags, n = 5)

      paste0("They are ", recent_row$W, "-", recent_row$L,

      "See the Pitching tab for the projected starter and the series-slot evidence behind it.",
      "See the Pitching tab for which relief arms are carrying recent workload.",
      "See the Spray & Splits tab for who actually runs and how often it works.",
      "See the Deep Dive tab for when in the game their runs have come."
    ),
    Type = rep("info", 5)
  ) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = need)
  five <- dplyr::bind_rows(five, filler)

}, character(1))

cat('<div class="insight-stack">', paste(five_html, collapse = ""), '</div>')
```
