### Season line

```{r hitter_season_table, results='asis'}
qualified_hitters <- dplyr::filter(hitters, Qualified %in% TRUE)

if (nrow(qualified_hitters) == 0) {
  cat(callout("No hitters cleared the qualifying sample for a season line."))
} else {
  tbl <- qualified_hitters |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(dplyr::coalesce(s_OPS, Reach))) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Player,
      Pos = fmt_chr(dplyr::coalesce(s_Pos, Pos)),
      Yr  = fmt_chr(s_Yr),
      G   = fmt_int(s_G), PA = fmt_int(s_PA),
      AVG = fmt_avg(s_AVG), OBP = fmt_avg(s_OBP), SLG = fmt_avg(s_SLG),
      OPS = fmt_avg(s_OPS), ISO = fmt_avg(s_ISO),
      HR  = fmt_int(s_HR), `BB%` = fmt_pct(s_BBpct), `K%` = fmt_pct(s_Kpct),
      SB  = fmt_int(s_SB)
    ) |>
    drop_empty_cols(keep = c("Player", "AVG", "OBP", "SLG", "OPS"))
  cat('<div class="table-scroll">')
  cat(ar_table(tbl))
  cat('</div>')
  cat(source_note(
    if (NCAA_OK) {
      paste0(
        "Source: stats.ncaa.org season totals, ", SEASON,
        ". Slash line recomputed from AB / H / TB / BB / HBP / SF rather than ",
        "read off the published rate columns. Qualifier: 40 or more plate appearances."
      )
    } else {
      paste0(
        "Source: the most recent ESPN season-to-date snapshot, which carries ",
        "only the slash line - games, plate appearances, home runs and stolen ",
        "bases are not in it, so those columns are dropped rather than shown ",
        "empty. Qualifier: ", MIN_AB_WINDOW,
        " or more at-bats in the recent window."
      )
    }
  ))
}
```

### Recent window

```{r hitter_window_table, results='asis'}
if (nrow(batting_window) == 0) {
  cat(callout("No hitter box-score rows were returned for the detail window."))
} else {
  window_tbl <- batting_window |>
    dplyr::filter(AB >= MIN_AB_WINDOW) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Reach)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Player, Pos, G, AB,
      AVG = fmt_avg(wAVG),
      `Reach%` = fmt_pct(Reach, 1),
      HR, BB, K, RBI, R,
      `Last game` = format(LastGame, "%b %d")
    )
  cat(ar_table(window_tbl))
  cat(source_note(
    "Source: ESPN game box scores, last ", BOX_GAMES, " games. ",
    "<strong>Reach%</strong> is (H + BB) / (AB + BB) - it is not on-base ",
    "percentage. ESPN game box scores do not publish hit-by-pitch or sacrifice ",
    "flies, so a true OBP cannot be built from this window and is not shown here. ",
    "Use the season line above for OBP."
  ))

  short_sample <- dplyr::filter(batting_window, AB < MIN_AB_WINDOW)
  if (nrow(short_sample) > 0) {
    cat('<h3>Limited sample</h3>')
    cat(ar_table(
      short_sample |>
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(AB)) |>
        dplyr::transmute(
          Player, Pos, G, AB, H, HR, BB, K,
          `Last game` = format(LastGame, "%b %d")
        )
    ))
    cat(source_note(
      "Under ", MIN_AB_WINDOW, " at-bats in the window. Shown as counting stats ",
      "only - rate stats on samples this size are noise, so they are not computed."
    ))
  }
}
```

<div class="section-kicker">Staff Preparation</div>

### Rotation projection

```{r rotation_table, results='asis'}
if (nrow(rotation_projection) == 0) {
  cat(callout("No starting-pitcher rows were available in the detail window."))
} else {
  next_desc <- if (!is.na(NEXT_GAME$opponent_label[[1]])) {
    paste0(
      format(NEXT_GAME$game_date[[1]], "%b %d"), " vs ",
      NEXT_GAME$opponent_label[[1]],
      if (!is.na(NEXT_GAME$series_slot[[1]]))
        paste0(" (game ", NEXT_GAME$series_slot[[1]], " of the series)") else ""
    )
  } else {
    "the next scheduled game"
  }

  cat(ar_table(
    rotation_projection |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Player, Starts,
        `Slot history` = SlotMix,
        `Starts in this slot` = SlotStarts,
        `Last start` = format(LastStart, "%b %d"),
        `Typical rest` = ifelse(is.na(TypicalRest), "—",
                                paste0(round(TypicalRest), " d")),
        `Days out` = ifelse(is.na(DaysToGame), "—", round(DaysToGame)),
        Projection = projection_html(Projection)
      ),
    escape = FALSE
  ))
  cat(source_note(
    "Projecting for ", html_escape(next_desc), ". ",
    "College staffs line up by series slot, not by rest days, so slot history ",
    "carries the most weight, discounted by recency, then penalised if there is ",
    "not enough rest. Every input is printed above so the call can be overridden."
  ))
}
```

### Starter workload

```{r workload_table, results='asis'}
if (nrow(workload) == 0) {
  cat(callout("No starts were recorded in the detail window."))
} else {
  cat(ar_table(
    workload |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Player, GS,
        `Typical outing` = TypicalIP,
        `Longest outing` = LongestIP,
        `Median pitches` = ifelse(is.na(MedPitches), "—", round(MedPitches)),
        `Max pitches`    = ifelse(is.na(MaxPitches), "—", round(MaxPitches))
      )
  ))
  cat(source_note(
    "How deep each starter has actually gone. This is where the opening is: ",
    "if a starter's typical outing ends around a known pitch count, the third ",
    "time through the order is when the plan changes. ESPN does not publish a ",
    "pitch count for every college game, so blanks here are missing data, not zeros."
  ))
}

  ))
  cat(source_note(
    "Source: ESPN game box scores, last ", BOX_GAMES, " games. ERA, K/9 and BB/9 ",
    "are computed from innings actually recorded in this window - they are not ",
    "the season figures. Innings are summed in outs, so a total can never come ",
    "out as an impossible value like 4.3."
  ))
}
```

### Scoring by inning

```{r scoring_plot, results='asis'}
scoring_by_inning <- if (nrow(run_ledger) == 0) tibble::tibble() else {
  run_ledger |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Inning), Inning >= 1) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Inning) |>
    dplyr::summarise(Runs = sum(FocalRuns, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(Inning)
}

if (nrow(scoring_by_inning) == 0) {
  cat(callout("Scoring-by-inning could not be built from the play-by-play."))
} else {
  plot_data <- tibble::tibble(Inning = 1:9) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::filter(scoring_by_inning, Inning <= 9), by = "Inning"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Runs = tidyr::replace_na(Runs, 0))

  max_runs <- max(plot_data$Runs, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_runs) || max_runs <= 0) max_runs <- 1
  plot_data <- dplyr::mutate(plot_data, Height = pmax(2, 100 * Runs / max_runs))

  bars <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(plot_data)), function(i) {
    paste0(
      '<div class="inning-column">',
        '<div class="inning-value">', plot_data$Runs[i], '</div>',
        '<div class="inning-bar-wrap">',
          '<div class="inning-bar" style="height:', plot_data$Height[i], '%;"></div>',
        '</div>',
        '<div class="inning-label">', plot_data$Inning[i], '</div>',
      '</div>'
    )
  }, character(1))

  cat('<div class="inning-chart">', paste(bars, collapse = ""), '</div>')
  cat('<div class="inning-caption">Runs scored by inning across ',
      PBP_GAMES, ' games with play-by-play</div>')

  early  <- sum(scoring_by_inning$Runs[scoring_by_inning$Inning <= 3])
  middle <- sum(scoring_by_inning$Runs[scoring_by_inning$Inning >= 4 &
                                         scoring_by_inning$Inning <= 6])
  late   <- sum(scoring_by_inning$Runs[scoring_by_inning$Inning >= 7])
  total  <- early + middle + late

  if (total > 0) {
    cat('<div class="metric-grid">', paste(c(
      metric_card("Early runs", early,
                  paste0(round(100 * early / total), "% of parsed runs"), "Innings 1-3"),
      metric_card("Middle runs", middle,
                  paste0(round(100 * middle / total), "% of parsed runs"), "Innings 4-6"),
      metric_card("Late runs", late,
                  paste0(round(100 * late / total), "% of parsed runs"), "Innings 7+"),
      metric_card("One-run games", ONE_RUN_RECORD, "Full season", "ESPN schedule"),
      metric_card(paste0(CONF_LABEL, " record"), CONF_RECORD, "Full season",
                  "ESPN schedule")
    ), collapse = ""), '</div>')
  }
}
```

<div class="section-kicker">Trust</div>
<div class="section-title">Where every number came from</div>

```{r dq_checks, results='asis'}
checks <- check_log()
if (nrow(checks) == 0) {
  cat(callout("No checks were recorded."))
} else {
  badge_class <- function(result) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      result %in% c("OK") ~ "dq-ok",
      result %in% c("POOR", "FAILED") ~ "dq-bad",
      TRUE ~ "dq-note"
    )
  }
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(checks)), function(i) {
    paste0(
      '<div class="dq-row">',
        '<div class="dq-badge ', badge_class(checks$Result[i]), '">',
          html_escape(checks$Result[i]), '</div>',
        '<div>',
          '<div class="dq-title">', html_escape(checks$Check[i]), '</div>',
          '<div class="dq-detail">', html_escape(checks$Detail[i]), '</div>',
        '</div>',
      '</div>'
    )
  }, character(1))
  cat('<div class="dq-grid">', paste(rows, collapse = ""), '</div>')
}
```

### Source and retrieval log

```{r dq_pulls, results='asis'}
pulls <- pull_log()
if (nrow(pulls) == 0) {
  cat(callout("No pulls were recorded."))
} else {
  summary_pulls <- pulls |>
    dplyr::group_by(Source, Status) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Items = dplyr::n(),
      Oldest = min(Retrieved, na.rm = TRUE),
      Newest = max(Retrieved, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Source, Status, Items,
      `Oldest retrieved` = format(Oldest, "%b %d %H:%M"),
      `Newest retrieved` = format(Newest, "%b %d %H:%M")
    )
  cat(ar_table(summary_pulls))

  failures <- dplyr::filter(pulls, Status == "FAILED")
  if (nrow(failures) > 0) {
    cat('<h3>Failed pulls</h3>')
    cat(ar_table(
      failures |>
        dplyr::transmute(Source, Item, When = format(Retrieved, "%b %d %H:%M"), Note)
    ))
  }
  cat(source_note(
    "Cached rows were read from the cache/ folder and carry the timestamp of ",
    "when they were originally downloaded, not of this render. That is the point ",
    "of showing it: a report built entirely from three-week-old cache should look ",
    "different from a fresh one."
  ))
}
```

### ESPN vs NCAA agreement

```{r dq_reconciliation, results='asis'}
if (nrow(reconciliation) == 0) {
  cat(callout(
    "No cross-source comparison was possible for this render - either the NCAA ",
    "source was unavailable or no hitters matched by name across the two sources. ",
    "Season rate stats in this report therefore rest on a single source."
  ))
} else {
  worst <- reconciliation |>
    dplyr::filter(MaxGap > 0.010) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(MaxGap)) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 12) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Player,
      `NCAA AVG` = fmt_avg(n_avg), `ESPN AVG` = fmt_avg(e_avg),
      `NCAA OBP` = fmt_avg(n_obp), `ESPN OBP` = fmt_avg(e_obp),
      `NCAA SLG` = fmt_avg(n_slg), `ESPN SLG` = fmt_avg(e_slg),
      `Largest gap` = fmt_avg(MaxGap)
    )
  if (nrow(worst) == 0) {
    cat(callout(
      "All ", nrow(reconciliation), " matched hitters agree within 10 points on ",
      "every rate stat across the two sources."
    ))
  } else {
    cat('<div class="table-scroll">')
    cat(ar_table(worst))
    cat('</div>')
    cat(source_note(
      "Hitters where the two sources disagree by more than 10 points. Some gap is ",
      "expected - the ESPN figure is a season-to-date snapshot taken from the last ",
      "box score in the detail window, so a team that has played since then will ",
      "differ. A large gap on a player who has not played recently is worth a look. ",
      "<strong>Where the two disagree, this report uses the NCAA figure.</strong>"
    ))
  }
}
```

### Play-by-play consistency

```{r dq_pbp_runs, results='asis'}
if (nrow(pbp_runs_check) == 0) {
  cat(callout("No play-by-play was available to test against the box scores."))
} else {
  mismatch <- dplyr::filter(pbp_runs_check, !Match)
  cat(callout(
    "<strong>Scoreboard reconstruction.</strong> Runs rebuilt from the ",
    "play-by-play scoreboard match the final score in ",
    sum(pbp_runs_check$Match), " of ", nrow(pbp_runs_check), " games. ",
    "Runs are taken as the highest score reached in each inning, differenced ",
    "across innings - not accumulated row by row, which is order-dependent and ",
    "loses any run whose row is filtered out."
  ))
  if (is.finite(TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY)) {
    cat(callout(
      "<strong>Text parse.</strong> Separately, the play text names ",
      fmt_pct(TEXT_RUN_RECOVERY), " of the runs actually scored. That figure ",
      "touches none of the score columns, so it is an independent check on the ",
      "parser behind the Spray &amp; Splits tab rather than a restatement of ",
      "the line above."
    ))
  }
  if (nrow(mismatch) > 0) {
    cat(ar_table(
      mismatch |>
        dplyr::left_join(
          dplyr::select(completed, game_id = event_id, game_date, opponent_label),
          by = "game_id"
        ) |>
        dplyr::transmute(
          Date = format(game_date, "%b %d"),
          Opponent = opponent_label,
          `Runs in box score` = Box_Runs,
          `Runs parsed from text` = PBP_Runs
        )
    ))
  }
}
```

### Method and limitations

```{r dq_method, results='asis'}
cat(callout(
  "<strong>Division of sources.</strong> Season rate stats come from ",
  "stats.ncaa.org and are recomputed from the counting stats. Recent-window ",
  "counting stats come from ESPN game box scores. Spray, situational and ",
  "baserunning tendencies come from ESPN play-by-play text. No column mixes two ",
  "of these."
))
cat(callout(
  "<strong>What this report cannot do.</strong> ",
  "There is no batting or throwing handedness in the public college feeds, so ",
  "there are no platoon splits and no pull/oppo - only field direction. ",
  "ESPN college play-by-play does not reliably name the pitcher on the mound, so ",
  "there are no per-pitcher batter-level splits; that material is reported at ",
  "staff level. ESPN game box scores omit hit-by-pitch, sacrifice flies, doubles ",
  "and triples, so a window slash line cannot be rebuilt from them and is not ",
  "shown. National percentiles are unadjusted for strength of schedule. ",
  "Runners-in-scoring-position state is reconstructed from text and is ",
  "deliberately conservative."
))
cat(callout(
  "<strong>Reproducing this render.</strong> baseballr ",
  as.character(utils::packageVersion("baseballr")), " · R ",
  paste0(R.version$major, ".", R.version$minor), " · ",
  "team query \"", html_escape(TEAM_QUERY), "\" resolved to ",
  html_escape(TEAM_NAME), " (ESPN id ", TEAM_ID, ")",
  if (!is.na(NCAA_TEAM_NAME)) paste0(", NCAA \"", html_escape(NCAA_TEAM_NAME), "\"") else "",
  " · detail window ", REQUESTED_GAMES, " games requested."
))
```

```{r panel_quality_close, results='asis'}
panel_close()
```

```{r footer, results='asis'}
cat(paste0(
  '<div class="footer">',
    html_escape(TEAM_NAME), ' · ', SEASON, ' opponent advance · ',
    'built ', format(Sys.time(), "%B %d, %Y at %H:%M"), ' · ',
    'sources: ESPN college baseball API',
    if (NCAA_OK) ' and stats.ncaa.org' else '',
  '</div>'
))

cat('</div>')
```
